purpose: Minimize time to process the untouched eligible remainder while preserving missingness, exact evidence, original validation and all historical liabilities.
entry: Research.execute with a separately registered implementation and the shared audited gateway; this design record is not a launch permission or an implementation.

route.scientific_body: Preserve exact frozen input, reasoning setting, max_output_tokens=4096, parser and validator.

pipeline.ramp: 16, 32, 64; after each group of 64 completed article attempts, double only if at least 90% have complete HTTP200 receipts, none reports 429, and durable saving is keeping up. Article validity is reported separately.
pipeline.prepare: One exact-count producer reuses verified counts only for identical request bodies. Stream each counted identity to the ready queue immediately; no manifest-wide count barrier.
pipeline.requests: Persistent pooled HTTPS transport, fixed origin, redirects disabled, no implicit SDK retries; credentials remain transport-private.
pipeline.timeout_limit: Longer read timeout is a proposed engineering choice, not a demonstrated fix. It does not prove cancellation of remote work.
pipeline.scheduling: One rolling pool across both corpora, preserving per-corpus identity and fair admission. Refill free slots as results are durably saved.
pipeline.checkpoint: Durably journal every intent before dispatch and every observed outcome before parsing. Store bounded checkpoint and progress summaries every 30 seconds without rescanning old source artifacts.
pipeline.backpressure: Stop admitting temporarily if the writer cannot durably save outcomes; never drop receipts to preserve throughput.

outcomes.valid: Save exact response, usage, unchanged validation and cost settlement.
outcomes.invalid: Save exact response and validation failure; retain as invalid, never repair or retry.
outcomes.policy_rejection: Save available receipt and error, preserve full unresolved cost, mark spent and continue other identities.
outcomes.parser_failure: Save exact response and parser failure, preserve full unresolved cost, mark spent and continue other identities.
outcomes.timeout_or_connection_loss: Preserve exact issued intent and available evidence as unknown remote outcome, retain full reservation, permanently exclude from dispatch and continue other identities only under the new registered policy.
outcomes.count_failure: Save the exact count intent and available receipt; skip the identity without a fabricated count or article request. Never retry the count.
outcomes.http_429: Retain the attempted identity and cost hold; delay all new admissions until Retry-After or rate-reset, at least 60 seconds when neither is available. Resume only on another untouched identity; never retry the failed one.
outcomes.burst_transport_failure: For each 64 completed article attempts, if at least 10% time out or return 5xx, halve target concurrency, minimum 16. Preserve existing calls and outcomes. Quarantine count alone does not stop work.
outcomes.hard_stop: Explicit user STOP, audit/hash/write failure, changed inputs, duplicate identity, auth/permission failure, provider quota exhaustion, unexplained cost overrun, budget or deadline exhaustion, and unclassified configuration errors.

ownership_and_recovery.parent: Keep the sealed parent and all older owners unchanged; preserve their STOP files and failed checks.
ownership_and_recovery.carry_forward: Before launch register and verify the full exclusion list, historical charges, reservations and every unresolved outcome. The 25 prior timeouts stay unknown with full holds; they are not reclassified as known or successful.
ownership_and_recovery.queue: Only frozen identities with no prior article intent and no failed or ambiguous count intent are eligible. Match corpus, source and packet hashes across the complete lineage.
ownership_and_recovery.restart: Reconstruct spent and pending state from the durable ledger. Never return an issued or uncertain intent to the ready queue. A fresh worker may claim only untouched identities after the new method's integrity gates pass.
ownership_and_recovery.stop: An explicit STOP is sticky. A supervisor cannot clear it. Old monitor remains paused during design.

monitor.review_action: Investigate full-window useful saved-result velocity including preparation and downtime. Keep a productive worker running. During confirmed widespread transient failure, pause new admissions for 60 seconds and attempt only one new untouched identity; grow concurrency only after recovery. No retries of spent identities.
monitor.eta: Use comparable cumulative outputs over 15-60 minutes. Exclude permanently spent quarantines. No current finish ETA while stopped.

release_checks_required: Preserved-history import rejects changed parent hashes, missing holds and overlapping identities.
Synthetic mixed outcomes including timeout, 429, policy error, malformed response and valid result continue only untouched identities.
Crash after durable intent but before receipt never causes redispatch.
Budget, deadline, lower rate ceilings, credential isolation and explicit STOP are enforced.
Existing parser and validation fixtures produce identical classifications.
Only after a separate launch instruction: one 15-minute run on untouched identities demonstrates throughput; this design does not claim that result.
